name: month-ai-usage
description: Shows in the status bar how much of your monthly AI credits (GitHub Copilot + Claude) you have used compared with the share of the working month already elapsed.

commands.title: Month AI Usage: Set Claude Session Key
Month AI Usage: Clear Claude Session Key
Month AI Usage: Select GitHub Account

monthAiUsage.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often usage data is refreshed, in minutes.

monthAiUsage.claude.organizationId.description: claude.ai organization UUID. Leave empty to auto-detect from your session.

monthAiUsage.claude.monthlyLimitUsd.description: Monthly spend limit in USD. 0 means read it from claude.ai.

monthAiUsage.warningThresholdPercent.description: Average usage percentage at which the status bar item turns to the warning colour.

monthAiUsage.errorThresholdPercent.description: Average usage percentage at which the status bar item turns to the error colour.

monthAiUsage.providerWarningThresholdPer.description: Usage percentage of a single provider that turns the status bar item to the warning colour on its own, even when the average is lower.

monthAiUsage.providerErrorThresholdPerce.description: Usage percentage of a single provider that turns the status bar item to the error colour on its own, even when the average is lower.

monthAiUsage.workingDays.markdownDescription: Days of the week counted as working days, where `0` is Sunday and `6` is Saturday. Defaults to Monday-Friday. An empty list falls back to the default.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.mjs --production
